    LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.lemma24b

    Bongartz's Lemma 2.4 (b) #

    For a convex set T' and a module V over the quotient algebra A' = A / ⟨e_v : v ∉ T'⟩: IrrIn V says that every irreducible map of A-modules into V starts at a module living on T'; IrrOut V says that every irreducible map out of V ends at such a module.

    irrIn_step: if T' is closed under successors and every proper predecessor of V has IrrOut, then V has IrrIn.

        theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.lemma24b {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {D : DirData k A} (sd : (z : D.ι) → Decomp (D.RadP z)) (hsd : ∀ z ∈ D.T, D.SepDecomp z (sd z)) {x : D.ι} (i0 : (sd x).ι) {𝒞 : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0)) → Prop} (h𝒞 : PreprojComp 𝒞) {U₀ : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))} (hU₀ : 𝒞 U₀) (habove : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))), 0 < m → PredN U₀ m V → ¬IsoM (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) V) ((sd x).obj i0)) (n : ℕ) (V : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))) :
        PredN U₀ n V → IrrIn (Bset x (sd x) i0) V ∧ (¬IsoM (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) V) ((sd x).obj i0) → IrrOut (Bset x (sd x) i0) V)

        Bongartz's Lemma 2.4 (b). Let C be a preprojective component over the quotient for B = Bᵢ(x), and U₀ ∈ C such that no proper predecessor of U₀ restricts to Rᵢ(x). Then for every predecessor V of U₀, irreducible maps of A-modules into V start in B, and if V does not restrict to Rᵢ(x), irreducible maps out of V end in B.
